verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents several latency and throughput features for latency-sensitive workloads. These include Fast serverless variants targeting 100+ tokens/sec, and dedicated on-demand GPUs promising lower latency and higher throughput. It also offers speculative decoding, quantization, and prompt-cache sticky routing, plus no cold starts on serverless and an open-source tool to benchmark throughput and latency. Missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token figures or guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the speed claims.
